newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-Australia bats first vs Board President's XI.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-Australia bats first vs Board President's XI.

text.p: Australia won the toss and decided to bat in their rain-affected three-day match against the Indian Board President's XI on Saturday.

The first two sessions were washed out due to a damp wicket and water-logged outfield, but the umpires declared the ground fit for play after four inspections, enabling two hours of play to be extracted from the opening day.
Australia: Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Michael Slater, Ricky Ponting, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy, Paul Reiffel, Damien Fleming, Glen McGrath and Peter McIntyre.

Indian Board President's XI: Sanjay Manjrekar (captain), Vikram Rathore, V.V.S. Laxman, Vinod Kambli, Pankaj Dharmani, Saba Karim, Sunil Joshi, Aashish Kapoor, David Johnson, D. Ganesh and Narendra Hirwani.
